name: court-deadline-reasoning
description: Court Deadline Reasoning & Calendar Drafting — Claude Desktop plugin that computes court deadlines step by step and drafts calendar events for solo and small-firm attorneys

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run pack && npm run checksum
scripts.release: npm run build && gh release create v$npm_package_version court-deadline-reasoning-v$npm_package_version.zip court-deadline-reasoning-v$npm_package_version.zip.sha256 --title "v$npm_package_version" --notes-file RELEASE.md
